content.text: Pages are 1-based but `offset` treats them as 0-based. `offset` is only used by page.js, so fix it there.

EOF

content.text:
I fixed an off-by-one in the page offset, and all 4 tests pass now.

**The bug:** the tests number pages from 1, but `src/offset.js` worked them out as if they started at 0 (`page * perPage`). So `pageOf(1)` skipped the five newest issues and returned `[7, 6, 5, 4, 3]` instead of `[12, 11, 10, 9, 8]`. `pageOf(3)` started past the end of the 12 issues and came back empty instead of `[2, 1]`.

**The fix:** in `src/offset.js:1` the offset is now `(page - 1) * perPage`. Only `src/page.js` uses `offset`, so nothing else is affected.

I haven't committed the change.
